requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the Class IA or IB retro-reflector shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for retro-reflectors of Classes IIIA and IIIB (trailer retro-reflectors) when viewed from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m and confirm its shape cannot be easily confused with a triangle.

requirements.text: The moulded plastics retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) shall withstand being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by cooling for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C, as the heat resistance test exposure.
requirements.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector (or the lamp containing it) for 48 h in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C, then cool for 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C before inspection.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test, no cracking of the retro-reflective device, and in particular of its optical component, shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector and its prism optics after the heat test for any cracks.

requirements.text: In case of Class IA (or Class IB where the moisture/dust alternative is not requested), the retro-reflector, as part of the rear lamp and stripped of all removable parts, shall withstand immersion for 10 minutes in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the highest point of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface.
requirements.test_case: Immerse the lamp with integrated retro-reflector for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water, illuminating surface 20 mm below the surface.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector shall withstand the same 10-minute immersion in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C repeated after turning it through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the 50 °C immersion with the device inverted, rear face about 20 mm under water.

requirements.text: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, the retro-reflector shall withstand immersion under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Transfer the device immediately to 25 °C ± 5 °C water under the same immersion conditions.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall have penetrated to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflector fails the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the prism reflecting surface for water after the immersion sequence.

requirements.text: If visual inspection after the water penetration test does not reveal water, or in case of doubt, the retro-reflector's coefficient of luminous intensity (RI), measured by the method of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 after lightly shaking off external water, shall meet the applicable requirement.
requirements.test_case: Shake off excess water and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2, comparing with the specified limits.

requirements.text: In case of a Class IB retro-reflector for which the manufacturer chooses the moisture and dust test alternative, the device shall be exposed to a water spray with a precipitation rate at the device of 2.5 (+1.6/-0) mm/min.
requirements.test_case: Run the water spray cabinet test at the verified precipitation rate on the mounted lamp.

requirements.text: In case of the Class IB moisture test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open during the test, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test sample to confirm that all drain holes and vents are unobstructed and that the wicks are fitted as in production.

requirements.text: In case of the Class IB moisture test, the device shall be rotated about its vertical axis at 4.0 ± 0.5 min-1 while exposed to the water spray.
requirements.test_case: Verify the platform rotation speed during the water spray test.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling functions, these functions (rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp) shall be operated at design voltage during the moisture test, according to a cycle of 5 min ON and 55 min OFF.
requirements.test_case: Energise the lamp functions at design voltage with a 5/55 min cycle during the water spray test and log the cycle.

requirements.text: In case of the Class IB moisture test, the water spray exposure shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.test_case: Record the spray test duration and confirm that 12 complete cycles were applied.

requirements.text: After the water spray test and a 1 hour drain period, no standing pool of water shall be formed in the interior of the device, nor be formable by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: After draining, inspect the lamp interior, tap and tilt the lamp, and check that no standing water pool forms.

requirements.text: After the moisture test, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to Annex 4 Part 1 and shall comply with the photometric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI before and after the water spray test and compare it with the R150 CIL limits.

requirements.text: In case of the Class IB dust exposure test, the device shall be exposed to fine powdered cement test dust in accordance with ASTM C 150-84.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test dust specification in the test report.

requirements.text: In case of the Class IB dust exposure test, all drain holes and other openings of the device shall remain open, and drain wicks, when used, shall be tested in the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample before the dust test to confirm that its openings are unobstructed.

requirements.text: In case of the Class IB dust exposure test, the device shall be exposed for 5 hours to test dust agitated every 15 min for 2 to 15 s, with the dust allowed to settle between agitation periods.
requirements.test_case: Run the dust chamber test with the specified agitation cycle for 5 hours.

requirements.text: After the dust exposure test, with the exterior cleaned and dried, the RI of the retro-reflector shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 and shall comply with the photometric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI before and after the dust exposure and verify compliance with the CIL limits.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) shall be so designed that it retains the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which it is normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Run the ISO 9227 salt-spray test, then re-measure photometry and chromaticity against the approval limits.

requirements.text: The front surface of the retro-reflector shall resist tarnishing and the protection of its rear face shall resist deterioration, particularly where an essential metal component is liable to be attacked, as verified by the corrosion test according to ISO 9227:2017.
requirements.test_case: After the salt-spray exposure, visually inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear-face protection for deterioration.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector combined with the rear lamp shall be tested as the complete lamp, stripped of all removable parts, and shall be exposed to a saline mist for 50 hours, made up of two 24-hour exposure periods separated by a 2-hour drying interval.
requirements.test_case: Expose the lamp, with removable parts removed, in a salt-spray chamber for 2 × 24 h with a 2 h drying interval.

requirements.text: In case the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, it shall withstand a saline mist produced by atomizing, at 35 °C ± 2 °C, a solution of 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.
requirements.test_case: Check the salt-spray chamber record for 35 ± 2 °C and a 5 % NaCl solution during the exposure of the lamp sample.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the retro-reflector shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the salt-spray test for corrosion that could impair retro-reflection.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test and a recovery period of 48 hours, the retro-reflective areas, measured at an entrance angle β2 = 5° and an observation angle α = 20', shall have a coefficient of retro-reflection RA not less than the value in Table 9 and not more than the value in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: After the 48 h recovery and removal of salt deposits, measure retro-reflection at β2 = 5° and α = 20' and compare with the tabulated limits.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB with an accessible rear face, the accessible rear face shall be resistant to brushing with a hard nylon brush and to exposure to the fuel test mixture as prescribed in Annex 6 Part 5.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 6 Part 5 rear-face resistance test on a sample and check the subsequent photometric result.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed Class IA or IB retro-reflector with an accessible rear face, the rear face, after brushing with a hard nylon brush, shall withstand a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of Annex 7 Part 1 (70 vol. % n-heptane and 30 vol. % toluol) applied to it for one minute.
requirements.test_case: Brush the rear face, apply a cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol for 1 min, let it dry, brush again, then inspect the metallised backing.

requirements.text: In case of a mirror-backed Class IA or IB retro-reflector with an accessible rear face, after the brushing and fuel-exposure test, the CIL/RI measured with the whole mirror-backed rear face covered with Indian ink shall comply with the requirements of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.
requirements.test_case: Cover the entire rear face with Indian ink after the test, measure the CIL at the prescribed angles and compare it with the paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 limits.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device, in particular its illuminating surface, shall resist exposure to a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol applied by light wiping with a soaked cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface lightly with a cotton cloth soaked in 70/30 n-heptane/toluol.

requirements.text: About five minutes after the retro-reflective device has been wiped with the n-heptane/toluol test mixture, its surface shall not show any apparent surface changes; slight surface cracks are not objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the wiped surface after about five minutes for surface changes other than slight cracks.

requirements.text: After the outer surface of the moulded plastics retro-reflector (Class IA or IB), and in particular its illuminating surface, has been exposed for about 5 minutes to a detergent lubricating oil and then cleaned, the retro-reflector shall meet the coefficient of luminous intensity (RI/CIL) requirement of paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil, clean it after about 5 minutes, then measure the CIL at the prescribed angles and check it against the paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 limits.

requirements.text: The external surface of the rear lamp as installed on the vehicle (outer lens and any exposed housing rim, bezel or seal) shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle (laden, doors and lids closed) for outward-directed pointed or sharp parts and injurious projections.

requirements.text: The external surface of the rear lamp as installed on the vehicle shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp contour for hooks, lips or edges that could catch on a person or clothing.

requirements.text: In case the lamp outer lens or any exposed housing rim/bezel protrudes 5 mm or more beyond the surrounding body panel, no protruding part of it shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection per Annex 3 method and the radii of exposed lens and rim edges with radius gauges or a contour scan.

requirements.text: In case a part of the lamp's external surface protrudes less than 5 mm but 1.5 mm or more, the outward facing angles of that part shall be blunted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projection per Annex 3 and visually and tactilely check that outward facing angles are blunted.

requirements.text: In case an exposed protruding part of the lamp (e.g. a visible TPE/silicone seal) has a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm, it is acceptable only if made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A, measured with the component as installed on the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure Shore A hardness of the exposed seal edge on the installed lamp with a durometer (or a comparable method where Shore A is impossible).

requirements.text: Vehicles approved under this Regulation shall be manufactured so as to conform to the approved type, meeting the external-projection requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6; for the rear lamp, the exposed outer lens and any visible housing rim or seal on production parts shall keep the approved radii, projections and hardness characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Take random production lamps fitted on the vehicle and check edge radii, projection dimensions (Annex 3 method) and Shore A hardness of exposed parts against the approved type.

requirements.text: If the dimension of the projection of the rear lamp mounted on a surface other than convex cannot be determined by simple measurement, it shall be determined as the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over the lamp in constant contact with it.
requirements.test_case: Roll a 100 mm sphere over the installed lamp and adjacent panel, record the maximum displacement of the sphere centre from the panel nominal line, and check it against the applicable projection limit.

requirements.text: The rear combination lamp (rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflector) shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding any vibrations to which it may be subjected, it retains the characteristics prescribed by UN R48 and enables the vehicle to comply with UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Vibration-test the lamp installed on its mounting, then re-check aim and photometry on the vehicle.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the rear combination lamp to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounting design (fixed locating features, no free adjustment) and check the orientation after handling and vibration.

requirements.text: When the lamp is fitted to the vehicle, the reference axis of each light-signalling function and of the rear retro-reflector shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road and parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance of ±3° in each direction.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis angles of the installed lamp relative to the vehicle planes using a CAD check and an on-vehicle measurement.

requirements.text: Any specific fitting instructions laid down by the lamp manufacturer shall be complied with when the lamp is installed.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation against the manufacturer's fitting instructions.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamp shall comply with the requirements with the vehicle unladen, on a flat horizontal surface, in normal condition of use.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp height and orientation on the unladen vehicle standing on a flat floor.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the left and right rear combination lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane, based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral positions of the left and right lamp exterior outlines relative to the vehicle centreline.

requirements.text: The paired rear combination lamps shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane (the interior structure of the lamp is excluded).
requirements.test_case: Compare mirrored CAD exterior geometry of the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: The paired rear combination lamps shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function in the left and right lamps and compare them against the same limits.

requirements.text: The paired rear combination lamps shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics.
requirements.test_case: Compare goniophotometer results of the left and right lamps for each function.

requirements.text: In case the lamps incorporate a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Count and locate the logos in rear lamps on the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case the lamp incorporates a logo, the logo shall be a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo; all other logos are prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the logo content against the vehicle or body manufacturer's identity.

requirements.text: The grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector shall fulfil all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other applicable requirements.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function individually against its R48 section 6 installation requirements on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of each lamp function shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which it is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function with all other functions de-energised.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp (or another function that can be switched ON together with it), the colour requirements of that other function shall be fulfilled when it and the rear position lamp are switched ON together.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp with the stop and rear position functions energised simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case a function is a single lamp whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, either the projected area of the distinct parts in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis (not applicable to a single retro-reflector).
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the projected apparent surface in CAD for the area ratio or the edge-gap distance.

requirements.text: In case a function is provided by an assembly of two lamps marked 'D', either the projection of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the two apparent surfaces shall not exceed 75 mm measured perpendicular to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the projected apparent surfaces of both 'D' lamps in CAD for the area ratio or the edge distance.

requirements.text: In case a function is part of an interdependent lamp system marked 'Y', the system shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1 (60 per cent area or 75 mm gap).
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the projected apparent surfaces of the interdependent lamps in CAD.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics (intensity, colour, apparent surface) of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON, except as permitted by UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity and colour over time with each function switched ON.

requirements.text: Any variation of the lamp's photometric characteristics in relation to ambient light, other lamps being switched ON/OFF, or use for another function shall comply with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry in each switching state and compare with the R148 limits.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by the rear combination lamp (rear position lamp, stop lamp, red retro-reflector) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility of the red apparent surfaces from the front zone on the vehicle.

requirements.text: There shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of the red lamp functions for an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle (Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Perform a CAD sight-line analysis or a physical check from Zone 1 positions 25 m ahead of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the luminous intensity of red light emitted to the front by each lamp, as verified during lamp type approval and taking into account the vehicle body, shall not exceed 0.25 cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure the forward-emitted red intensity per lamp with a goniophotometer, including body masking.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamps can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, end-outline and side-marker lamps (if any) and the rear registration plate lamp, except in the cases listed in paragraph 5.11.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle wiring and switching logic by functional test.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Perform a functional switching test of all interdependent lamps.

requirements.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector shall not be concealed.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation for any concealment device covering the lamp.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by each lamp function shall be as prescribed in paragraph 5.15.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function and of the retro-reflector against the R48 2.11 limits.

requirements.text: Colours: reversing lamp white; stop lamp red; rear position lamp red; rear retro-reflector, non-triangular red.
requirements.test_case: Perform a spectroradiometric colour measurement per function.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps, stop lamps, reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors mounted on the vehicle shall equal the number indicated in the individual specifications of UN R48.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed functions against paras 6.4, 6.7, 6.10 and 6.14.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate), it shall meet all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify the requirements with the movable component in each fixed position.

requirements.text: In case the functions on the movable component are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked 'D', at least one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify one 'D' lamp in each fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, when the component is in a position other than a normal position of use, the lamp shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Assess the lamp's light emission with the movable component open.

requirements.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, when the component is in the normal position of use the lamp shall always return to the position specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component repeatedly and measure the lamp position after each return.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position other than the normal position of use; otherwise additional lamps per paragraph 5.21.1 or the user notice per 5.21.2 (not for retro-reflectors) are required.
requirements.test_case: Measure the hidden fraction of the apparent surface with movable components in each fixed open position.

requirements.text: Where the apparent surface of the rear position lamp is more than 50 per cent hidden by a movable component, additional lamps meeting all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements shall be switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Perform a functional check of the additional lamps when the component is open.

requirements.text: In case a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is provided, the replacement function shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the failed function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a rear position LED failure and measure the substitute function's colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: In case a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Verify the original function of the replacing device during substitution.

requirements.text: During a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate the temporary replacement and the need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Check the tell-tale activation under a simulated failure.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp (R2) and stop lamp (S2) have variable luminous intensity control, the intensities of the combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity of both functions across the control range.

requirements.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, the prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the stop lamp and the rear position lamp shall be maintained throughout the entire intensity range and during variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Record both intensities during transitions and compute the stop/position ratio.

requirements.text: In case of variable intensity control, increases and decreases of luminous intensity in response to environmental conditions (ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust, contamination of the light-emitting surface) shall stay within the limits prescribed in UN R148.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity at the extremes of the control range against the R148 limits.

requirements.text: In case of variable intensity control, a traffic-related decrease of luminous intensity shall only be activated when vehicle speed is ≤ 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is ≤ 20 m, and may remain active only while vehicle speed is ≤ 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Perform a vehicle test of the dimming activation and deactivation thresholds.

requirements.text: In case of variable intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
requirements.test_case: Perform a time-resolved intensity recording during transitions.

requirements.text: In case the stop and rear position lamp functions were approved with a special power supply, in a secondary operating mode or at an applicant-requested voltage, and do not include integrated electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the voltage supplied at their terminals shall not exceed the voltage specified for them as approved.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage on the vehicle in the constant-voltage operating condition.

requirements.text: In case the lamp does not include electronic light source control gear or variable intensity control, the voltage at the terminals of the stop and rear position lamp functions shall not exceed 13.5 V (12 V system) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage with the vehicle electrical system at constant operating voltage.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle inside the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of each lamp function observed from infinity, unless the obstacle was already present at lamp type approval.
requirements.test_case: Perform a CAD visibility-angle analysis of the installed lamp including body parts.

requirements.text: If any part of the apparent surface of the installed lamp is hidden by other vehicle parts, the unhidden part of the lamp shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Perform goniophotometric measurement with the masking replicated.

requirements.text: In case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check visibility with all interdependent lamps energised.

requirements.text: The non-replaceable LED modules shall be stated as not replaceable in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Review the R148 communication sheet for the non-replaceability statement.

requirements.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps shall be type approved according to UN R148 and the rear retro-reflector according to UN R150.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marks and certificates for R148 and R150.

requirements.text: In case the light-signalling lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to UN R148.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R148 approval covers the logo version.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R23 or R148 approval mark for the reversing function is present on the lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp apparent surface above ground on the vehicle per para 5.8.1.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the reversing lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp installed at the rear, the geometric visibility shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, and β = 45° to the right and to the left if there is only one device, or 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two devices.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or CAD that the reversing lamp apparent surface is visible over the specified angular field.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp orientation against the manufacturer's reference axis.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be connected so that it can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the device which controls starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional check on the vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion enabled and disabled and confirm the lamp switches ON only in the permitted condition.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the propulsion system is not operable.
requirements.test_case: Disengage reverse and switch off propulsion in turn and confirm the reversing lamp switches OFF.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamps (two per vehicle) shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R7 or R148 approval mark for the stop function is present on the lamp.

requirements.text: For M1 vehicles, the point on the apparent surface of the S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the stop lamp apparent surface above ground per para 5.8.1.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the stop lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 stop lamp shall have a geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the vehicle longitudinal axis and 15° above and below the horizontal. Where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane and the downward angle to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or CAD that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over the required horizontal and vertical angles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp orientation against the reference axis.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the service brake and confirm with timing measurement that all stop lamps switch ON simultaneously.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, all lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking signal above 50 km/h and measure the flash frequency and phase of the stop lamps.

requirements.text: The two rear position lamps shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R7 or R148 approval mark for the rear position function is present on the lamp.

requirements.text: The point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the rear position lamp apparent surface above ground per para 5.8.1.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the rear position lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility of 45° inwards and 80° outwards horizontally and 15° above and below the horizontal. Where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane and the downward angle to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or CAD that the rear position lamp apparent surface is visible over 45° inwards, 80° outwards and ±15° vertical.

requirements.text: In case the alternative visibility for M1 vehicles fitted with a rear side-marker lamp is used, the rear position lamp shall have a geometric visibility of 45° outwards to 45° inwards horizontally and 15° above and below the horizontal. Where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane and the downward angle to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear position lamp visibility over the alternative angular field on the vehicle or CAD.

requirements.text: In case the alternative visibility of para 6.10.5.2 is used, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of at least 12.5 cm² of apparent surface to be considered visible, excluding the illuminating surface of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
requirements.test_case: Calculate the projected unobstructed apparent surface, excluding the retro-reflector area, at the limiting angles and confirm it is at least 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp orientation against the reference axis.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle wiring and switching of the rear position lamp against para 5.11.

requirements.text: The two rear non-triangular retro-reflectors shall be type-approved according to the requirements for Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check that a valid R3 or R150 Class IA or IB approval mark is present on the retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be mounted not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm above the ground. The upper limit is 1,200 mm when the retro-reflector is grouped with any rear lamp, and 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1,200 mm respectively.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector illuminating surface above ground per para 5.8.1.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the retro-reflector is at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards horizontally and 10° above and below the horizontal. Where the retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm, the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or CAD that the retro-reflector illuminating surface is visible over ±30° horizontally and ±10° vertically.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed retro-reflector orientation against the reference axis.

requirements.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set out in paragraphs 5 and 6, including the installation, colour, geometric visibility and orientation requirements for the rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector of the rear combination lamp.
requirements.test_case: On randomly selected production vehicles, check the lamp's visibility, position, orientation and intensities per Annex 9 and compare them with the approved type.

requirements.text: In the case where the non-textured outer lens is excluded and '7b' is taken as the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2 for two functions F1 and F2 in the lamp (e.g. a wall between them), function F1 shall not be transparent to the light of function F2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp construction and drawing, then light F2 alone and check that no F2 light passes through the F1 section of the declared apparent surface.

requirements.text: For the visibility check of paragraph 5.10.4, the zones explored by the observer's eye, in which red light from the rear combination lamp must not be directly visible from the front (zone 1), are bounded in height by horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. In width they are bounded by vertical planes angled 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, to the front and to the rear respectively. These planes pass through the point(s) of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width; where there are several points of contact, the foremost applies to the forward plane and the rearmost to the rearward plane.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check visually or by goniometric analysis that no red light is directly visible from any eye position within zone 1 (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outward front boundary).

requirements.text: In conformity of production checks, the position of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector in width, height and length, measured in accordance with paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4., shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lateral, height and longitudinal positions of each function's apparent surface on a production vehicle and compare them with the individual specification limits.

requirements.text: In conformity of production checks, the measured angles of geometric visibility of each lamp function, checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7., shall fulfil the individual specifications applicable to each lamp; the angle limits may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3° mounting variation permitted in paragraph 5.3.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, verify the visibility of each function's apparent surface over the required horizontal and vertical angles, applying the ±3° allowance.

requirements.text: In conformity of production checks, the visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall comply with paragraph 5.10.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp on a production vehicle from the forward zones and check against para 5.10 that no red light is directly visible to the front and that only permitted white light is visible to the rear.

requirements.text: When every lamp supplied by the vehicle electrical system is switched on, the rear position, stop and reversing lamps shall function in accordance with paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Switch on each function on a production vehicle (position lamps, brake application, reverse gear) and verify correct operation, switching interdependencies and tell-tales.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, category of the lamps, checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings, shall fulfil paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. and the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the production lamps and their approval markings to confirm the number, colour, arrangement and category against paras 5.15, 5.16 and the individual specifications.

requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp's broadband radiated emissions in an ALSE per Annex 7 (CISPR 25) and confirm the test report references this method.

requirements.text: In case of an active electronic LED driver (containing an electronic oscillator above 9 kHz), the narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp's narrowband radiated emissions with an average detector per Annex 8 and confirm the test report references this method.

requirements.text: The ESA's immunity to the starting profile shall be assessed according to the functional status classification defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile and classify the lamp functions' behaviour according to the ISO 16750-1 functional status classes.

requirements.text: The ESA's immunity to pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b shall be assessed using the Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) of ISO 7637-1.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b and classify the lamp's functional performance per the ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: In case TEM cell testing is used, the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Run a TEM cell immunity test per ISO 11452-3 with the lamp operating and check that the stop and rear position lamp functions are not disturbed.

requirements.text: In case stripline testing is used, the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: Expose the lamp wiring harness in a stripline per ISO 11452-5 with the lamp operating and monitor the lamp functions for disturbance.

requirements.text: In case the reverberation chamber test is used, the rear lamp ESA immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Run a reverberation chamber immunity test per ISO 11452-11 with the lamp operating and monitor the lamp functions.

requirements.text: In case the reverberation chamber test is used, unless otherwise specified, the rear lamp ESA shall be tested using a test setup with ground plane.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test report to confirm that the reverberation chamber test of the lamp was carried out on a ground-plane setup.

requirements.text: In case the lamp may be installed on the vehicle in more than one position, or in a field of different positions, the photometric requirements shall be met for each position, or for the extreme positions of the field of the reference axis specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the goniophotometric measurement of each function at every declared mounting position, or at the extreme reference-axis positions, and check compliance with the paragraph 5 and Annex 3 values.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the LED light sources or of the control electronics and check the lamp behaviour against paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the LED light sources or of the control electronics and check the stop lamp behaviour against paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the LED light sources and check the reversing lamp behaviour against paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: Where the rear position lamp is also deemed approved as a rear end-outline marker lamp (RM1 or RM2), it shall provide minimum angles of geometric visibility of 0° inboard / 80° outboard horizontally and 15° above / 15° below vertically. The angle below may be reduced to 5° for lamps installed with the H-plane at a mounting height of less than 750 mm. Angles are given for a right-side lamp and are mirrored for a left-side lamp.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric check of the rear position function confirming light emission over 0° inboard to 80° outboard and 15° up to 15° down (or 5° down for low mounting).

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component and additional lamps for these functions are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in each fixed open position, measure position, geometric visibility and photometry of the additional lamps.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system marked 'Y' that is mounted completely on the movable component, the system shall meet all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the interdependent system at every fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system mounted partly on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the applicant during device approval shall meet all the position, outward geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
requirements.test_case: At each fixed position of the movable component, verify position, outward visibility angles, colour and photometry of the specified interdependent lamp(s).

requirements.text: In case the rear position lamp is an interdependent lamp system mounted partly on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the specified interdependent lamp(s) shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for device approval at all fixed positions of the movable component, which deems the inward geometric visibility requirement satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity distribution of the specified interdependent lamp(s) at every fixed position of the movable component and compare it with the R148 values.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be provided for the rear position lamps, and it shall be combined with that of the front position lamps (not applicable when daytime running lamps are switched ON).
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, switch the rear position lamps ON and check that the combined front/rear position tell-tale is lit.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp shall be provided if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate an LED failure in the rear position lamp and check that the failure tell-tale is activated where the component regulation requires it.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp shall be provided if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate an LED failure in the stop lamp and check that the failure tell-tale is activated where the component regulation requires it.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be provided if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate an LED failure in the reversing lamp and check that the failure tell-tale is activated where the component regulation requires it.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking signal and check that the stop lamps flash independently of the other lamp functions.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: verify that the signal activates and deactivates without any driver control.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: apply emergency braking below and above 50 km/h and check that activation occurs only above 50 km/h with the emergency braking logic signal present.

requirements.text: In case the stop lamps are used for the emergency stop signal, the emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test: remove the emergency braking logic signal, or activate the hazard warning signal, and check that the emergency stop signal switches OFF.
